proof_body:
by
  rintro f a hf ⟨L, hL⟩
  have hfi : ∀ t : ℝ, MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn f (Set.Ioc a t) := fun t =>
    ((hf.mono Set.Icc_subset_Ici_self).integrableOn_compact isCompact_Icc).mono_set Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self
  have hI : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn f (Set.Ioi a) :=
    MeasureTheory.integrableOn_Ioi_of_intervalIntegral_norm_tendsto L a hfi Filter.tendsto_id
      (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, id] using hL)
  exact ⟨_, MeasureTheory.intervalIntegral_tendsto_integral_Ioi a hI Filter.tendsto_id⟩
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ), ContinuousOn f (Set.Ici a) → (∃ L : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun t => ∫ x in a..t, |f x|) Filter.atTop (nhds L)) → ∃ L : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun t => ∫ x in a..t, f x) Filter.atTop (nhds L)
